N001.summary: At the start of the game, focus on establishing a solid economic and technological foundation. Maintain current economic and technology development while keeping production moderate. Avoid overcommitting to a specific army composition until more information is available.
N001.title: Early Game Foundation
N001.trigger_summary: At the start of the game, focus on establishing a solid economic and technological foundation.

N002.summary: As the game progresses into the early-midgame, maintain the economic and technological lead while starting to build a ground-based army. Continue to maintain the current path, focusing on expanding the economy and technology while producing Stalkers for defense. Keep production moderate to allow for flexibility.
N002.title: Early-Midgame Transition
N002.trigger_summary: As the game progresses into the early-midgame, maintain the economic and technological lead while starting to build a ground-based army.

N003.summary: In the midgame, consolidate the army composition and production to match the opponent's strategy. Maintain the current army path and production, but be ready to adapt based on scouting. Continue to expand and tech up while keeping a strong defense.
N003.title: Midgame Consolidation
N003.trigger_summary: In the midgame, consolidate the army composition and production to match the opponent's strategy.
